capabilities: Insert, delete and move table rows and columns
Edit tables in a visual grid with drag-to-select
Merge and split cells with ^^ and || syntax
Paste tables copied from Excel or web pages
extras: Installed by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugin folder. Warns on load if Table Extended is enabled; running both together is not supported. Headerless tables may not render in Obsidian's own views.
intentEvidence: GUI shortcuts (insert / delete / move row & column, alignment) — replaces Advanced Tables
motivation: To combine the most useful pieces of three popular table plugins into a single, modern UI.
problem: Markdown tables in Obsidian must be edited as raw pipes, with no grid view, no cell merging, and no easy way to bring in tables from spreadsheets or web pages.

relations.evidence: GUI shortcuts (insert / delete / move row & column, alignment) — replaces Advanced Tables
Visual grid editor with drag-to-select and merged-cell support — replaces Markdown Table Editor
fully compatible with Table Extended / MultiMarkdown syntax — replaces Table Extended

summary: All-in-one Markdown table toolkit with a floating toolbar, a visual grid editor, and merged-cell support using MultiMarkdown syntax.
